flags.why: The common meaning 'full, with no space left' is missing, as in a room filled with people or a fully booked schedule ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/K%C3%ADn)).
flags.fix: adj | full; completely occupied; fully booked. Ex: Lịch tuần này của tôi kín rồi. = My schedule is fully booked this week.

flags.why: In this example, tình cảm refers to goodwill or affection, not to the watch or money itself.
flags.fix: Remove this sense; the example belongs under affection or goodwill.

flags.why: Bình means to comment on or critically discuss poetry; reciting is expressed by ngâm in the example.
flags.fix: to comment on; to critically discuss (poetry)

flags.why: Bốc thuốc means preparing or dispensing herbal medicine according to a prescription, rather than making the prescription ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/B%E1%BB%91c)).
flags.fix: to prepare; to dispense (traditional herbal medicine)

flags.why: This is an enema vessel used to irrigate the bowel, not a container for cleaning butchered intestines ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/B%E1%BB%91c)).
The example incorrectly presents the enema vessel as equipment for washing pig offal.
flags.fix: Y tá chuẩn bị bốc để thụt rửa cho bệnh nhân. = The nurse prepared the enema irrigator for the patient.

flags.why: The example defines the title instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Vị hoàng tử ấy cùng vương phi dự buổi lễ. = The prince attended the ceremony with his consort.

flags.why: The example explains that cốc is an old plant name instead of using it to refer to the plant.
flags.fix: Ông chỉ cho tôi cây cốc bên đường. = He showed me the cốc plant beside the road.
